issues.description: Inconsistent getter naming for the StockIngredient 'name' field between template and solution. The template repository defines and uses getIngredientName() (StockIngredient.java and Stock.findStockIngredient()), while the solution repository uses getName() (StockIngredient.java and Stock.findStockIngredient()). The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields" but does not specify names, so comparing template and solution will be confusing. This naming mismatch across artifacts may mislead students or cause integration issues if reference solution code or tests expect a specific getter name.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the getter name for the StockIngredient 'name' field across all artifacts. Prefer a single canonical name (e.g., getName()) and update the template StockIngredient and Stock to use that getter, or alternatively change the solution to use getIngredientName(). Also update the problem statement to mention the expected getter names (or explicitly state that any reasonable getter name is acceptable) to avoid ambiguity.

issues.description: The getter for the StockIngredient 'name' field is named getIngredientName() in the template but getName() in the solution. Corresponding usages in Stock.findStockIngredient also call different methods (template calls getIngredientName(), solution calls getName()). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual property (the ingredient's name) across problem/template/solution can confuse students when mapping the problem description to the provided code and the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the getter name for the ingredient's name across all artifacts. Use a single identifier (e.g., getName()) in StockIngredient and update all call sites (Stock.findStockIngredient and any other references) in the template and solution to use that same getter. Alternatively, standardize on getIngredientName() everywhere — but ensure template, solution, and examples in the problem statement consistently use the same name.
